items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: Dick Haymes didn’t know. Dick Haymes stood in front of the microphone like a poker. Because Dick followed Frank.

ctx.x: Wow. Was he a skinny little kid then?

Oh, yeah. Yeah, he was skinnier than the microphone. He was good though. Right away you could tell he knew how to use his hands. Because in New Jersey he used to work on the floor, you know what I mean? So he knew how to carry himself and everything. Dick Haymes didn’t know. Dick Haymes stood in front of the microphone like a poker. Because Dick followed Frank. Because Dick’s mother was a vocal teacher. But Dick was, gee I remember when he joined the band he was just like a — but out came this beautiful voice…
Well when you say Frank worked on the floor, he was interacting more with the audience right up close in New Jersey?
